samples.Reference: Ms. Dawson helps #Person1# to write a memo to inform every employee that they have to change the communication method and should not use Instant Messaging anymore.
samples.Baseline: Ms. Dawson, Attached is a draft memo to all employees.
samples.LoRA r=4: #Person1# asks #Person2# to take a dictation for Ms. Dawson. Ms. Dawson asks #Person1# to go out as an intra-office memorandum to all employees by this afternoon.
samples.LoRA r=16: #Person1# asks #Person2# to take a dictation for Ms. Dawson. Ms. Dawson tells #Person1# that the use of instant messaging programs by employees during working hours is strictly prohibited.

samples.Reference: #Person2# arrives late because of traffic jam. #Person1# persuades #Person2# to use public transportations to keep healthy and to protect the environment.
samples.LoRA r=4: #Person1# is stuck in traffic again. #Person2# thinks it would be better if #Person1# started taking public transport system to work. #Person1# thinks the public transport system would be better for the environment.
samples.LoRA r=16: #Person1# tells #Person2# that #Person2#'s got stuck in traffic again. #Person2# thinks it's better if #Person1# started taking public transport system to work. #Person1# thinks biking to work would be better for the environment.
